canon-dune:kaitain.x: Seat of the Padishah Emperor and House Corrino following the devastation of Salusa Secundus.

new-horizons.x: Fifth solar-escape spacecraft; conducted flybys of Pluto (2015) and Kuiper Belt contact binary 486958 Arrokoth (2019).

proxima-centauri-d.x: Sub-Earth candidate orbiting Proxima Centauri every 5.1 days at just 4.25 light-years, one of the lightest known extrasolar planets.

gaia-4792774797545800832.x: Young, massive super-Jupiter embedded in a massive debris disk, completing an entire rotation in just 8.1 hours (equatorial speed ~100,000 km/h).
